content.what_it_is: Minimal MATLAB example (tools/read_format) showing how to read a FUNWAVE-TVD binary output field: sets grid dimensions m=3190, n=10100 (L2-3), opens snapshot file 'eta_00006' (L4), reads an m-by-n single-precision array with fread '*single' (L5), closes (L6), transposes to row=y orientation (L7) and displays with pcolor shading flat (L8). Lines 9-10 are blank.
entities: script (no functions); variables: m @L2, n @L3, fileID @L4, eta @L5 (transposed @L7)

equations.ref: transpose to (n x m) plot orientation

unresolved: m=3190, n=10100 are case-specific dimensions (Mglob x Nglob of some run) with no comment identifying the case; file 'eta_00006' implies FUNWAVE binary output naming but the producing case is not stated
